prompted_for: Seven system families along the path water travels (home page 'Seven system families, one water path'; became the WaterPath component)
composition: diagonal zigzag descent from top-left to bottom-right
seven equipment vignettes staggered along one continuous double-line pipe
each station paired with a large numeral and two-line caps title
section title anchored left-centre in a quiet zone
registration crop marks at the frame edges
layout_devices: one continuous pipe route linking all items
ghost oversized numerals behind solid numerals
small boxed instrument tags (COND., TOC, PSI, TEMP) beside each station
entry label tab ('city feed') where the pipe starts
exit arrow at the end of the route
tag legend row along the bottom edge
faint centre crosshair and edge tick marks
typography: light-to-regular condensed grotesk caps for titles
tiny mono caps inside tag boxes
rendering: no shading or fills except pipe
line_and_texture: pipe drawn as parallel double line with soft glow
faint quadrant guide lines and crop ticks
motion_implied: water travels along the pipe from city feed to point of use
stations light up in sequence as the flow reaches them
ghost numerals fade in behind numerals
t2i_keywords: serpentine zigzag path top-left to bottom-right
double-line pipe in muted steel blue
crop marks and edge tick marks
t2i_prompt: Wide 16:9 web section on a deep navy background, drawn as a technical blueprint: <CONTENT> shown as a sequence of small isometric equipment vignettes in hairline off-white line art, staggered diagonally from top-left to bottom-right and linked by one continuous double-line pipe in muted steel blue. Each station has a large light numeral, a faint oversized ghost numeral behind it, a short condensed sans-serif caps title and tiny boxed monospace instrument tags. Crop marks and edge ticks frame the field. Flat vector, no shading, one cool accent colour, generous negative space, calm and precise.
signature_idea: The site's offer is drawn as one pipe that water actually travels, with each system family a station on it.
strengths: explains the whole product line as one physical flow engineers recognise
single accent on the pipe gives a clear reading path
numbering and tags feel like real documentation
weaknesses: seven vignettes plus tags is dense at phone width
ghost numerals and tags add noise
stations shown are stainless/WFI/steam, broader than the polypropylene PW offer
diagonal route is hard to reflow responsively
brand_fit_why: Navy ground, limestone line work, single steel-blue pipe accent and square tags are on-brand; condensed caps differ from Geist light and the density undercuts 'space as a material'.
